verdict.rationale: Cloudflare exposes a comprehensive REST API (openapi.json probe) and management via Wrangler CLI, plus an MCP server exposing 2,500+ endpoints, indicating broad API/UI parity for account and resource management. However, evidence doesn't confirm every dashboard-only feature (e.g. certain analytics views, billing UI, some Zero Trust console workflows) has a documented API equivalent, and community comments note DX friction versus dashboard use. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all dashboard-exclusive features (analytics dashboards, billing management, some Zero Trust UI panels) have full API parity, and independent verification of 100% UI/API feature parity.
